# Custom Pools & Spas

![](https://springlakepools.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/IMG_2208-1024x768.jpeg)

![Designing & Constructing Custom Pools](https://springlakepools.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/SpringLakePools-aboutus-768x1024.jpeg)

## DESIGNING & CONSTRUCTING CUSTOM POOLS AND SPAS

Our family-owned company has designed, created, and installed thousands of custom-designed pools and spas. Our premier technology and design features ensure the best possible pool or custom-built spa dreams come to life. Contact us today for more information.

## Looking to build

## Your Pool or Spa

###### Call Us Now

[(570) 855-4235](tel:+15708554235)

## CUSTOM POOL DESIGN & CONSTRUCTION

We can create infinity edges, water features, stairways, acrylic walls, grottos, sun tan ledges and benches and many other unique designs. From lap pools to Olympic-sized pools, we can make your swimming pool as small or as large as you desire.

### CUSTOM SPAS & HOT TUBS

Our custom spas and hot tubs all offer soothing sounds, a hydro massage, and a warm place to relax. Our custom spa line includes luxury spas, hot tubs, and swimming pools with connected spas. We can fit your style and design of spa or hot tub anywhere on your property. We’ll help determine the best type of custom spa to meet your needs.

[Get in Touch](https://springlakepools.com/contact/)

![High-Quality Construction Process](https://springlakepools.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/SpringLakePools-Construction.jpeg)

#### HIGH-QUALITY CONSTRUCTION PROCESS

Our custom pool and spa construction process includes the highest quality of work and communication. We’ll ensure our construction process provides you with the best value of pool or spa possible. From the first design meeting to the final inspection, we’re there for you every step of the way to answer questions and keep you updated on our process. Our custom swimming pool contractors put your needs first, taking pride in their work and providing exceptional products.

##### CUSTOM POOL ADDITIONAL OPTIONS

We’re bringing your swimming pool dreams to life, so it must be perfect. We can include additional options like custom rockwork, deck jets, water features, rain arcs, LED lighting, fire pits, and more. We design aquatic features using our 3D CAD design technology, allowing you to choose between hundreds of tile samples. Our custom pool creations have endless options to make your oasis come to life.

![Custom Pool Additional Options](https://springlakepools.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/SpringLakePools-Spa-Building-1024x768.jpeg)
